meta.name: cs-ticket-triage
meta.description: Triagem e priorização de ticket ou problema de suporte. Use ao receber um novo ticket que precisa de categorização, atribuição de prioridade P1-P4, decisão sobre qual time deve tratar, ou verificação de duplicidade antes de encaminhar. / Triage and prioritize a support ticket or customer issue. Use when a new ticket comes in and needs categorization, assigning P1-P4 priority, deciding which team should handle it, or checking whether it's a duplicate or known issue before routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分类和优先级排序客服工单
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要手动分类和分配客服工单
copy.tagline_en: Automatically categorize and prioritize support tickets
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often manually categorize and assign support tickets

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会根据输入的客户问题或票据文本，自动执行分类、分配P1-P4优先级、推荐处理团队、检查重复已知问题，并输出结构化评估和初始回复草稿。
howto.when: 当您遇到需要分类的新支持票据时，使用 /cs-ticket-triage 命令并附上问题描述，即可触发自动分类评估。

say.note: 技能将分析并给出优先级和建议。

say.text: /cs-ticket-triage 客户无法SSO登录，返回403错误
say.note: 技能将分析并给出优先级和建议。
技能将分析并给出优先级和建议。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude will classify the input ticket, assign P1-P4 priority, recommend handling team, check for duplicates/known issues, and produce a structured triage with suggested initial reply.
howto.when_en: Trigger by using the /cs-ticket-triage command with the ticket text when you need categorization, priority assignment, routing decision, or duplicate check for a new support ticket.

say_en.note: The skill will analyze and provide priority and recommendations.
